request: Create a mature dry rice field tile with tall rice, visible soil in the center, low root mounds, slight lateral transparency, and a gentle wind sway.

immutable.canvas: 128x128 RGBA composite atlas plus a 128x128 RGBA plant overlay
immutable.tile_fill: crop-field soil remains visible in the center between the tall rice rows
immutable.shadow: subtle transparency is limited to the lateral rice silhouettes
immutable.motion_events: Renderer loops eight pixel-snapped, height-weighted wind frames every 100 ms, matching the tree sprite cadence; roots and soil stay fixed.

allowed_changes: dense ripe rice heads and stems
dry golden ochre and straw-brown color ramp
tall ripe rice heads and stems
lower, thinner rough earth ridge at the roots
visible tilled soil in the center between crop rows
slight lateral transparency on the plant silhouette
eight-frame horizontal wind sway with upper rice bending more than the rooted lower stems
small position and shading variations among tiles
identity_to_preserve: Kingdom cozy medieval cartoon pixel-art language
crisp pixel clusters and dark navy outline
warm earthy materials with controlled highlights
the 64x64 tile format used by the existing crop and rice field atlases

tolerances.transparent_pixels: limited to small irregular corner/edge gaps

validation_status: tree reference measured as an eight-frame loop; rice wind atlas has eight distinct 100 ms frames with unchanged root pixels; production build passes; live motion still needs an in-game mature crop tile for visual confirmation
